name: Alpha Partner USDA
oneLiner: USDA is Alpha Partners' BSC-only dollar token whose backing is described only as protocol-managed collateral and liquidity reserves; mechanism opaque.
collateral: Undisclosed and unverified. AP Web3 / Alpha Partners markets USDA as 1:1 USD-backed by reserves with 'FDIC protection', but publishes no reserve composition, proof of reserves, or attestation; the FDIC claim is unsubstantiated (FDIC does not insure stablecoins). Backing is opaque.
pegMechanism: Undocumented. The issuer publishes no mint/redeem or peg-maintenance mechanism. On-chain USDA is a BSC ERC-20 with a role-gated mint, an address blacklist, and modifiable transfer tax/fees; no peg-stabilization process is described.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

reserveReview.rationale: The reviewed Alpha Partners website and documentation describe the AP U-Card, USDT top-ups, and the broader platform but do not identify USDA, its reserve assets, reserve accounts, custodians, balances, mint/redemption backing controls, or an independent reserve report. No primary reserve-composition source was available. The prior protocol-managed collateral label is therefore narrowed to an explicit undisclosed-reserve bucket rather than implying unsupported asset classes.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: No primary USDA reserve-composition disclosure found in the reviewed issuer corpus
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All reserve asset identities, weights, obligors, custodians, legal safeguards, liquidity terms, valuation methods, and asset-versus-liability reconciliation remain unknown.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The reviewed official issuer surfaces do not publish a USDA reserve source from which a composition could be authored.

mintAuthority.summary: Alpha Partners' USDA is a BSC ERC-20 whose verified token source restricts mint() to a MINT role with no on-chain supply cap, but public RPC reads cannot enumerate the current MINT or DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders.

controls.label: USDA MINT role-gated token contract
controls.capDescription: Contract has no maximum supply cap; addresses granted the MINT role can issue USDA without an on-chain limit.
controls.evidence: BscScan-verified source exposes mint() restricted to keccak256('MINT') and role-admin controls, with no maximum-supply check. At BSC block 111074103 the token had 17,338 bytes of code and zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots; owner(), getOwner(), and role-member enumeration calls reverted, so the active MINT and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders are not established.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-20. BSC RPC at block 111074103 confirms the deployed USDA code and zero standard EIP-1967 slots. BscScan source identifies a role-gated MINT mint() path with no supply ceiling and MINT role hash 0xfdf81848136595c31bb5f76217767372bc4bf906663038eb38381131ea27ecba. getRoleMemberCount reverts, and an all-history RoleGranted log request is rejected by the public RPC as limit exceeded; these results do not identify the active minters or default admins. No reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor is evidenced by the reviewed materials.
unresolvedQuestions: Enumerate the active MINT and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE holders for 0x17eafd08994305d8ace37efb82f1523177ec70ee. getRoleMemberCount is unavailable and the public-RPC all-history RoleGranted scan is range-limited; use an indexed BSC log provider or issuer disclosure before assigning any controller addresses or threshold.
Establish whether the non-proxy token has any non-standard upgrade or migration route. Zero EIP-1967 slots alone do not prove immutable mint logic.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDA presents an issuer-controlled one-dollar reserve claim; weak disclosures affect evidence quality but not the mechanism family.
